text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Functions Citation and and Con8equential Provisions) Order, 1991 and shall be deemed to Commencehave come into force on the 1st day of August, 1990. ment.

In this Order unless the context otherwise requires -Interpretation. ''Functions'' includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority. ''Minister'' means the person appointed under subsection (4) or 19) of Section 4 of the Constitution who is for the time being charges with the responsibility for the subject matter to which the written law specified in the Schedule refers.

The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority Transfer of specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of law functions. specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.
